chapter: Tulane, Tuxedo and Waifs' Home bands
title: First brass band job with Old Man Allen and his Navy years
summary: His first brass band job was with Old Man Allen; he left the Navy in 1919 and began playing in 1922.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Let's see. That's interesting. Uh, did you play with the, uh, Onward Brass Band ever? The old Onward? Yeah, the old Onward. No. What about the Excelsior?
I didn't play with any of them. Uh, Old Man Allen? What about him? Oh, you know I played with him. Yeah. He had one of my first bands.
Tanner Island. Mm-hmm. What was your first brass band job? Do you remember?

Uh, I knew it was, the first brass band job I had was with Old Man Allen and that was in Algeist. Mm-hmm. How old were you then? Uh, I was, um, twenty, let me see, it must have been around twenty-three, twenty-four years ago.
You've been out of the Navy a while when you got there.
I came out of the Navy in 1919. I didn't start to playin', really out playing music till 1922.
All right. What about Allen's band? Who was in that? Uh. You don't remember? No, I had, I know me and Gordette was playing with him.
